name: When should I engage a construction company for my restaurant build-out?

mainEntity.name: When should I engage a construction company for my restaurant build-out?

acceptedAnswer.text: It's advisable to engage a construction company as early as possible in your restaurant build-out journey, ideally even before finalizing your lease or purchasing a property. An experienced builder can provide valuable insights during site selection, assess feasibility, and offer preliminary budget estimates. They can also collaborate with your architect and design team from the outset, identifying potential constructability issues or cost-saving opportunities. Early involvement ensures a more streamlined process, better cost control, and a smoother transition from concept to completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Engage a construction company early, ideally during site selection, to benefit from their expertise in feasibility, budgeting, and collaboration with design teams.
